settings.q: How do I put it on?
settings.a: Stick one tab on each side of your nostrils, then snap the band on. The magnets click into place in about 2 seconds.

settings.q: Which tab size do I need?
settings.a: Medium fits most people. Pick Small for a narrow nose or Large for a wide one. Not sure? Start with Medium.
Noctara helps you breathe through your nose, which many people find reduces nose-related snoring. It is not a medical device and doesn’t treat sleep apnea — talk to a doctor if you think you have it.

settings.q: Can I wear it while working out?
settings.a: Yes. The tabs are sweat-resistant and the band is light, so it stays put through runs, lifts and rides.

settings.q: How long do the tabs last?
settings.a: Each pair of tabs is for one use. The band is reusable — just reorder tabs.
